summary: Iteration 111: Automation Rules Rewrite Testing. All 29 backend tests passed (100%). The complete rewrite of the Automation Rule system is working correctly with new schema: trigger_type, action_type, field_mappings, target_panel_id, relation_field. All validations work as expected. Frontend builds without errors.

frontend_issues.notes: Frontend builds successfully. UI requires Firebase Auth for testing. Code review confirms all new features are correctly implemented.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 111 tested the complete rewrite of the Automation Rule system. New schema uses flat structure: trigger_type, action_type, target_panel_id, relation_field, field_mappings[], field_visibility[], update_operation, update_field, update_value_from. All validations work correctly. Execution engine supports create_records_per_item (loops through line items), duplicate prevention, and event chaining with infinite loop protection. All 8 system modules return correct fields via module-fields endpoint.
features_tested: POST /api/business-tools/automation/rules with new schema (trigger_type, action_type, field_mappings, target_panel_id, relation_field)
GET /api/business-tools/automation/rules returns enriched rules with panel names and new fields
GET /api/business-tools/automation/logs returns logs with new fields (action_type, message)
Rule validation: trigger_type must be in allowed set (on_create, on_update, condition_based)
Rule validation: action_type must be in allowed set (update_record, create_record, create_records_per_item)
Rule validation: create actions require field_mappings
Rule validation: update_record requires update_operation, update_field, update_value_from
Rule validation: relation_field must exist in trigger panel and be type relation
Rule validation: condition_based trigger requires condition
Rule validation: invalid condition operator returns 400
GET /api/business-tools/panels/module-fields/{module_id} returns correct fields for all 8 system modules

CreateRuleRequest.name: string (required)
CreateRuleRequest.field_mappings: [{ target_field, source_field, default_value, mapping_type }] (required for create actions)
